About Us

Meet April Mendenhall

More than two decades of experience. A commitment to raising the standard.

Hi, I’m April Mendenhall, Principal Broker and Owner of Coastal & Arbor Real Estate Group.

Real estate has been my passion for more than 20 years. Throughout my career, I’ve had the privilege of helping many buyers, sellers, property owners, investors, landlords, and tenants navigate one of life’s biggest investments with confidence.

I founded Coastal & Arbor Real Estate Group with one goal in mind—to create a brokerage where relationships come before transactions and every client receives the attention, communication, and professionalism they deserve.

Meet Amy Heilig

Amy Heilig

Realtor® | PM Certified Property Manager

With nearly 20 years of experience in residential property management, Amy Heilig is a licensed Realtor® and PM Certified Property Manager proudly serving homeowners and residents throughout Hampton Roads. Known for her approachable personality, strong work ethic, and genuine care for others, Amy is passionate about building lasting relationships and providing an exceptional property management experience from start to finish.

Throughout her career, Amy has managed every aspect of residential property management, including marketing rental homes, leasing, tenant relations, maintenance coordination, inspections, lease administration, owner communication, and investment property oversight. She understands that every property - and every client - is unique, and she takes pride in providing personalized service, honest communication, and practical solutions that protect her clients' investments while creating positive experiences for residents.

Amy believes that successful property management is built on trust, responsiveness, and attention to detail. Whether she's helping a first-time landlord navigate the rental process or assisting a seasoned investor with a growing portfolio, she is committed to treating every property as if it were her own.

Outside of work, Amy enjoys spending time with her husband, Josh, and their family, especially making memories with her grandson, Milo, and eagerly anticipating the arrival of her granddaughter later this year. In her free time, she enjoys crafting, home design, and spending time with her beloved animals.

Amy's combination of professional credentials, industry knowledge, and nearly two decades of hands-on experience has made her a trusted resource for property owners throughout Hampton Roads. She is committed to delivering responsive, dependable service while helping clients maximize the value of their investment properties.

About Coastal & Arbor

People, relationships, and a secure future.

At Coastal & Arbor Real Estate Group, real estate is about more than transactions—it’s about people, relationships, and helping our clients build a secure future.

With more than 20 years of experience serving Hampton Roads, we offer a full range of residential and commercial real estate, property management, leasing, and investment services backed by integrity, communication, and attention to detail.

Whether you’re purchasing your first home, selling a property, growing your investment portfolio, searching for commercial real estate solutions, or looking for professional management, we’re committed to delivering a personalized experience and exceptional results.

Our goal isn’t simply to complete a transaction—it’s to become your trusted real estate partner for years to come.

Experience

Guidance across every side of real estate.

Residential Real EstateBuying, selling, relocation, and first homes.
Commercial Real EstateSales, leasing, and investment opportunities.
Property ManagementResidential and commercial management.
Investment PropertiesPortfolio planning and investor consulting.
Rental ManagementShort-term and mid-term solutions.
LeasingTenant placement and lease support.

I believe in being honest, responsive, and proactive. Whether I’m helping a family purchase their first home, assisting an investor in growing their portfolio, managing rental properties, or guiding a commercial client through a complex transaction, I approach every opportunity with the same level of dedication and care.

As a business owner and real estate professional, I understand that every client has different goals. My job is to listen, educate, solve problems, and provide the guidance needed to help you make informed decisions with confidence.

At Coastal & Arbor, we’re not just here for a single transaction—we’re here to become your trusted real estate partner for years to come.

But my vision reaches far beyond today. I’m building a brokerage with a foundation strong enough to outlive me—one built on integrity, exceptional service, and a commitment to raising the standard for our industry. My hope is that Coastal & Arbor becomes a lasting legacy that continues serving our community for generations to come.

Most importantly, I’m building this company for my two boys. I want them to see that hard work, honesty, compassion, and perseverance can create something meaningful. Every client I serve, every relationship I build, and every decision I make is driven by the desire to create a legacy they can one day be proud of.

Thank you for considering Coastal & Arbor Real Estate Group. I look forward to helping you achieve your real estate goals.

Real estate isn’t just about properties—it’s about people, relationships, and building a future. That’s the standard I strive to create every single day—for my clients, my community, and my boys.
